biggest_catch: freemyapps.com still exists (promos current Sept 2026), but the company publishes no official credit-to-dollar conversion and no minimum — and third-party math doesn't even agree with itself (1,500 credits cited as both $4.50 and $5.00). There is no verifiable payout term. A 2026 review also reports ongoing management inconsistency and reward-crediting problems.
catches: No official conversion rate or minimum published by the company; all figures come from third parties and conflict.
Recent (2026) independent review: 'I can't recommend FreeMyApps' — cites an 'incredibly long endeavor to earn any income' and 'management issues and inconsistency'.
Reward is gift cards only (Amazon/iTunes tiers cited at $5/$10/$25 by third parties) — no cash option documented officially.
Registration historically required a verified Facebook account (per the app's own description).
iOS has no dedicated app — iPhone users must use m.freemyapps.com in Safari, with fewer offers than Android.

c1.evidence: FreeMyApps — freemyapps.com / welcome.freemyapps.com still live with current (Sept 2026) promotions; official FAQ at support.freemyapps.com referenced in the company's own app description ('Over $31 Million in Gift Cards Earned').

c2.evidence: FAILED — no concrete payout terms published by the company. App description lists reward types but no conversion; moneymakerland cites 1 credit=$0.003 while also citing 1,500 credits=$5.00 (which would be $0.00333) — internally inconsistent third-party figures.

c3.evidence: Free to join; no participation fee.

c4.evidence: Official app-description copy and current promo pages obtained; they confirm the program mechanics but not a payout rate.

eligibility: Smartphone; Android app or iOS via Safari web app; verified Facebook account historically required for registration.
